description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment Hapuwalana, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510050
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific details about parcel numbers, cadastral maps, land extents, and geographic locations (village, division, district). The content focuses on administrative corrections to land records (expunging particulars and amending land area measurements), which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification for land and property-related matters.
